const a = await tools.progress.append_progress({content: `STAGE 1 -- design triage for a hyperbolic SID-table metric (metric_ideation_2).
GOAL: pick a construction that is in the contract, is orthogonal to HBAA (+0.701) and to the refuted families, and has a mechanism that can still improve on +0.634 (Q_H).
READ: only the task brief for this round (no SID tables or reference arrays are mounted in this sandbox: the working dir holds just running.json/progress.jsonl/session.jsonl/stderr.log/opencode.json, so no measurement was possible and none is claimed).
OBSERVED/REASONED: (a) every metric of the partition's own geometry failed (Voronoi margin -0.081, adjusted R2 +0.156, Frechet cover radius -0.146, bucket reach +0.041, path likelihood -0.488 with a -0.78 confound on level-2 bucket count); (b) the family that works is a per-item contrast that uses the frozen reference on BOTH sides, with the training history as the query point (HBAA). So a new proposal must stay in the contrast family (otherwise it lands below +0.16) but change the object, not just the reduction.
REJECTED on the way, with reasons: (1) entropy/lift of the level-1 partition, chance-corrected by cell sizes -- I proved to myself it is monotone increasing in resolution: with one item per cell the cell anchor equals the item's own point, so the behavioural overlap becomes exactly the reference's own kNN agreement and the statistic saturates near its ceiling, i.e. it rewards item-id shattering. This is the same trap that killed the path likelihood from the other direction. (2) hyperbolic k-means vs the table by NMI -- needs Lloyd iterations in the ball, seeding constants and 20x pass cost, and is close to 'a Stage 2 run'. (3) surrogate R@10 by simulating a beam over cells -- a one-cell table trivially contains the answer under any containment-based surrogate, so the metric must model capacity truncation, which turns it into a hidden Stage-3 on training pairs (contract risk) at ~3e9 flops. (4) softmax over -d_H alone -- a monotone reparametrisation of any pairwise distance ordering, so it would be 'Euclidean in disguise' unless the anchors themselves are curved barycentres.
OPEN at this stage: the chosen construction and its exact formula.`});

const b = await tools.progress.append_progress({content: `STAGE 2 -- chosen construction and contract check (metric_ideation_2).
GOAL: fix one formula and verify it against the five contract clauses.
CONSTRUCTION: hxt_tail_l1. The table enters only through the level-1 code k_i. The reference enters through BOTH towers: the cell anchor A_c is the Lorentz/Einstein centroid of the TARGET points of the cell's members, and the query Q_i is the Lorentz/Einstein centroid of the SOURCE points of i's training history (the predicted item removed). The per-item statistic is the log-ratio of the reference's own Gibbs bucket evidence, Delta_i = tau*ln(sum_c nu_i(c)*exp(-d_H(Q_i,A_c)/tau)) - tau*ln(sum_c pi_i(c)*exp(-d_H(Q_i,A_c)/tau)), where pi_i/nu_i are the positive/negative TRAINING-partner distributions over level-1 cells; the metric is mean_i Delta_i/tau.
WHY THIS IS NOT A RESTATEMENT OF HBAA (the three structural differences I can defend): (i) TARGET tower vs HBAA's source tower -- HBAA's history barycentre and its cell barycentres both live in the source space, so history members pull their own cell anchor toward the query; the cross-tower version makes the query and the anchors live in different halves of the model, which removes that self-consistency bias and matches the Stage-3 scorer, which is a source-to-target score; (ii) the reduction is a soft-min (exponential tail) over the whole cell set, not a first moment, and no barycentre of cells is ever formed -- the object is a pair of distributions compared through the reference's own logit, which is the quantity R@10 is decided by (the hardest competitor), whereas HBAA averages ten negatives; (iii) the geometry is anchored to the reference's own score: on the hyperboloid the reference's logit is -cosh(d_H)/tau, so the softmax over geodesic distance in units of tau_ref is the reference's own posterior over buckets, with tau read, not tuned.
CONTRACT CHECK: hyperbolic construction -- Lorentz centroid (the Frechet mean of the squared-geodesic loss in a curvature -1 ball, closed form) plus arcosh geodesic distance; curvature K=-1 stated, and d_H is not a monotone function of |x-y| alone (it carries the conformal factor (1-|x|^2)(1-|y|^2)), so the bucket posterior is curvature-sensitive, not a flat softmax. Computable from the table plus the frozen reference plus the training split: yes. No leakage: only training pairs, no validation/test pair, no recall. Fixed form: only K=-1 and tau_ref, both derived/stated. One number: yes.
SANITY CHECKS I ran by hand: one level-1 code -> pi=nu=delta -> Delta=0 exactly (collapse scores 0, not a reward). Random relabelling -> pi and nu are two exchangeable draws from the same size distribution -> E[Delta]=0. Singleton cells -> A_c=V_j -> Delta reduces to a reference-only constant, so the metric degrades to table-independence rather than exploding. Worst realistic table -> level-1 code = popularity/frequency band: the item's own (large) band attracts the random negatives' cells while co-occurring partners scatter, so Delta goes clearly negative.
OPEN: writing the answer block as the final record.`});

console.log("ok", JSON.stringify(a), JSON.stringify(b));
